resolution.note: lane start and canary use worktree add --no-track; ship pushes without -u; regression test red without the fix.

title: Lane start and ship work while a running lane holds the git config lock
body:
Why: while a lane session runs, its harness sandbox mounts an empty read-only placeholder over <main>/.git/config.lock (observed 2026-11-13 17:04, 0 bytes, r--r--r--, no git process). Every .git/config write in the shared git dir then fails: krn lane start (worktree add -b with upstream tracking) failed twice, and ship push -u would fail to set the upstream.
Outcome: lane start, the adopt canary and pr ship write no git config, so they work beside running lanes.
Proof: test/cli/lane.test.ts "lane start works while a running lane sandbox holds .git/config.lock" fails without --no-track (exit 1) and passes with it.
